title: LedgerCloseMeta v1 with 2000 evicted keys: 1000 temporary contract-data entries and their 1000 TTLs
why: Eviction is ledger-level, not attributed to any transaction: this ledger's evictedKeys lists 2000 LedgerKeys, 1000 temporary CONTRACT_DATA keys of one contract and their 1000 TTL keys. Readers that look for deletions only in transaction meta keep 1000 dead entries; readers that bound the list size small drop the ledger.
notes: 745 transactions under Protocol 22. All 1000 evicted contract-data keys belong to CAFJZQWS… and have u128 keys. Evicted keys rarely appear on pubnet. The lake object was written by stellar-core 23.0.1 long after the ledger closed (source.regenerated true), so its TransactionMeta is v4 with backfilled classic and fee events, not what a node emitted at the time.
